name: Client Project Setup
description: One read-back-verified client-project context record and, only when exactly selected, a no-launch finance setup handoff.
audience: Solo operators and agencies organizing lightweight client-engagement context.
problem: Agency and standalone operators need durable engagement orientation without inventing a second project-management or finance system.
outcome: One read-back-verified client-project context record and, only when exactly selected, a no-launch finance setup handoff.
operatorPath: Supply the engagement identity and brief context, with optional agency association, guidance, and finance navigation pointer.
Review the saved engagement record and separately decide whether to set up exact finance workflows.
agentPath: Inspect current-project engagement records and resolve an existing or stable new engagement reference from supplied identity before strict run validation.
Resolve any supplied or preserved agency association only against agency-profile resources in that same current project; stop before writing if it is unresolved.
Merge supplied facts with permitted existing optional context, persist one engagement record, and read it back.
Return a setup_existing finance handoff only for exact selected workflow keys; do not launch it.
recovery: If stable engagement identity conflicts with existing context, stop for operator direction rather than overwriting or creating a duplicate.
safeStoppingPoints: Stop after engagement context is verified. Finance setup is a separate optional handoff and is never started implicitly.
prerequisites: A currently bound StackOS project and operator-supplied engagement identity.
proof: and a bounded optional finance handoff.
whenToUse: A client engagement needs minimal durable context in an agency or standalone workspace.
An existing engagement context needs a reviewed update under its stable reference.

stages.title: Inventory Existing Engagement Context
stages.summary: Inspect bounded current-project project-context records and resolve one stable engagement identity.

stages.title: Resolve Supplied Engagement Facts
stages.summary: Produce the complete write payload by merging supplied facts with permitted existing optional context.

stages.title: Persist Client Project Context
stages.summary: Upsert the resolved complete engagement payload under its stable external id.

stages.title: Read Back And Hand Off
stages.summary: Verify the saved engagement resource and return the optional finance setup handoff without executing it.
